name: Grande Centre Point Sukhumvit 55 Thong Lo
detail: This hotel is a 'real' 5 star hotel. I've stayed in three 5 star hotels in Bangkok prior to Grand Centre Point. This beats them all. The staff are fun and consistently polite to guests. They play with the children interact with the guests and add a nice feel to the hotel. Breakfast had flavourful, good quality produce which was great for 320baht if you don't include breakfast in your booking. The design of the hotel is stylish and modern plus the view from our 26th floor room was amazing. You could see Bangkok for miles. head to the pool with a glass barrier around the outside where Bangkok can be seen... as well as heard quite well! One problem with it was the gym it was a little empty however you don't really spend your time in a gym! One last problem was the Spa area. I really wanted to just go inside and see it before I booked anything however this was prohibited. Even when no one is using it you still can't have a look with a member of staff.

name: Grand Howard Hotel
detail: My son (15), my two daughters (12 and 9) and me stayed at the Grand Howard Hotel for nine nights. It was our first stay in Asia (even our first stay outside of Europe). The staff of the Grand Howard Hotel was very welcoming. The hotelroom was big, clean and had all comfort you need. We had a corner room in the 17th floor and could enjoy a spectacular view of Bangkok because of the very big windows. My children especially enjoyed the big swimming pool in the 6th floor. Part of it is roofed (protected from the sun) so you can use it at all day times. But the most we loved the staff of the hotel. They gave us good advice about what to see in Bangkok and they gave us a warm welcome every time when we returned to the hotel. We felt like being home. Thanks a lot to the staff of the Grand Howard Hotel!

name: The Quarter Ladprao by UHG
detail: This is an amazing hotel I’d rate it 5 stars. So clean and lovely pool and and nice restaurant. Little bit outside Bangkok but grab is cheap and there’s also a station at union circle centre. The rooms are spacious and brand new. Can’t fault it. Only thing is I’d say they can improve breakfast by separating meat and pork for Muslim and other vegetarian guests.

name: Centara Grand at Central Plaza Ladprao Bangkok
detail: Centara has 2 hotels in Bangkok, this one and Centara Grand at Great world - don't get mixed up. The one at Great World is the bigger (and more expensive) one - but there you also are facing more traffic jams. But it all depends on the purpose of your visit. I did stay in Centara Grand at Central Plaze because we had meetings in Chon Buri, Rayong and Bangkok as well - and this location made it quite easy and fast to travel to the Eastern Sea Board and also to access the business district in Bangkok without too much jam. Also, if you are going back to the new airport in the early afternoon it takes only 30 minutes (taxi approx. 300 Baht). The check-in was fast and efficient, staff at this place very friendly and helpful. Rooms are nicely renovated (have stayed here before a few years back), amenities are well sorted and whatever you need is available. Breakfast is amazingly good, huge spread of different foods, good bread and nice coffee, service a bit slow at rush hour times. The Cappucino Caffee (part of the coffee house) offers cakes, snacks and nice salads if you don't want to eat a full meal. Housekeeping and Engineering function well - no reason at all o complain. Internet seems to be a bit difficult, there is a relatively new law in Thailand regarding wireless log-in - so, it needs some time to get it all set up. Anyhow, if you want to eat somewhere else and not in the hotel (they have several different restaurants, though), there is easy access directly from the hotel to Central Plaza where you can find plenty of restaurants and a decent food court (The Loft) as well. At the same time you can get all your shopping needs covered in this shopping centre - or you take the MRT to other big malls not so far (don't try taxi because that might take a very long time, depending on traffic conditions, which are usually bad). The hotel is still in a kind of upgrading process (by mens of administrative organisation), i.e. check-out at present is a bit slow - but ok.

name: Ibis Bangkok Sukhumvit 24
detail: 'Ibis Bangkok Sukhumvit 24' is 'Mercure Bangkok' and vice versa. It's a new hotel - everything is good. Located just a few steps away from BTS Skytrain station 'Phrom Phong' - very convenient. But, the room is a little bit small - thus feel confined when maneuver within the limited space. They have 82 TV channels (if you have time to watch!). Fruits for breakfast should have more varieties - to reflect Thailand, as garden of fruits. There is a halal restaurant 'Usman' - about 500m away.

name: ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit Phra Khanong
detail: We had a pleasant stay at Ibis Styles Hotel. So far this is the best hotel I have ever stayed in Bangkok. They do provide shuttle service to BTS station (or you may walk to the BTS station, just a 5-mins walking distance). Friendly staff and I would give 5 stars for the cleanliness. But I would recommend first-timer to stay in Pratunam which would be more convenient. For those who is looking for hotel accommodation in Sukhumvit, this is definitely a best choice for you.

name: ibis Styles Bangkok Silom
detail: The staff are friendly and are available 24 hours.

name: Diamond Bangkok Apartment
detail: I liked the location. Usually I have stayed in the Banglamphu area, the backpacker place to stay. After staying there for the last 25 years whenever in Bangkok I felt like I needed a change so chose Siam area. I arrived very early, 7am, I was able to take a room at 9am. The staff at reception were not the friendliest, but at least I got my room early. The road in front of the hotel is very busy, but the room was quiet enough. The usual A/C. fridge, T.V. you expect at this price range. Wifi was good. I don't think the hotel had food, but around I found the best street food and cheap but great food restaurants I have found in Bangkok. The hotel is a ten minute walk to the massive MBK shopping mall and the impressive Siam Discovery Centre. I spent hours walking around these places until my feet were aching too much, how wonderful to have a foot massage later! Anyway, back to the hotel, it's a bit on the expensive side for me but is good value for money. For short stays in Bangkok with plenty of local shopping options I can recommend and will likely stay there again. Also close to the BTS Skytrain and Jim Thompson house.

name: Montraj Continent Sukhumvit Bangkok
detail: I enjoyed the stay at the Continent. It clearly follows a successful formula for Bangkok of providing a sophisticated product that comes across as having all the frills. The staff we genuinely hospitable and very efficient and professional and were helpful throughout which is a standard for all the better hotels in Bangkok. Ftether than that I would say my experience of the staff was on a par with hotels that might be charging a rate of 50% more. It does not really have the size and scale to feel like a 5 star property, I think that it is better classed as a very good quality boutique 4-star hotel. The rooms like the above indicates were well thought out with sexy design elements and fairly good quality fittings and maintenance but uses a lot of clever design ideas to mask the fact that they are not in fact all that large hence my reluctance to agree that it is a 5-star property. That said it was a quality and enjoyable experience staying in the room. Certainly for the price the hotel delivered plenty of value and is an easy recommendation to friends and family who want to stay. -there also was not much sign of any of the sleaziness that can be evident in other hotels in Bangkok.

name: Grand Mercure Bangkok Atrium
detail: My wife and I stayed at the Amari Atrium Bangkok Hotel for 4 days. After being disappointed with a hotel we booked in Malaysia we were afraid that we might face the same sort of experience. But it was clear from the moment we got off the taxi that our stay at the Amari Atrium would be a pleasant one. As expected, it was. From the bell hop attending to your luggage, to a swift check in, for the people at the elevators helping us to find the right floor, we have not had a single day of bad experience. Even the service staff helped us understand the different between 'Sawadee krup' and 'Sawadee ka'! Can't be any more happier with our stay. Definitely a 5 star service!
